messages:
maya (docs): Morning — heads up about a scheduled merge cascade for the migration + examples refactor. A few PRs touch the same anchors and previews are flaky. PRs: #4380 (move migration -> /guides/migration/overview.md), #4384 (examples rename + redirect map), #4387 (SDK v2 snippet edits), temporary redirect PR #4390. Current failing preview: https://deploy-preview-4380--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/migration/overview.html#migrate-step-2

kevin (eng): Saw that. The problem is previews resolve anchors against the moved path; if the redirect isn't present previews break. We should land the small redirect first, then the move, then cleanup.

zoe (platform): Agreed. I'll open a tiny PR with one-line redirect and set the link-checker job to WARN-only for a 40m window around the merge. That avoids spamming the pipeline during the cascade.

ci-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4380 failed: 1 broken link -> /guides/migration.html#migrate-step-2

maya (docs): Proposed merge order: (1) #4390 temporary redirect -> merge (2) #4380 move migration -> merge (3) #4384 cleanup redirects + rename examples -> merge (4) #4387 snippets -> merge. Requesting reviewers: @kevin for #4380, @leo for #4387. Target window: today 14:00-15:00 PT. Any blockers?

kevin (eng): No blockers. I'll prioritize reviewing #4380 once #4390 is merged. Local repro: run `yarn docs:build && ./bin/link-checker ./_site` to reproduce the anchor error. Example error: "Missing anchor 'migrate-step-2' in guides/migration.md"

leo (docs): I'll review #4387. Note: SDK v2 renamed `helper.formatMd()` to `helper.formatMarkdown()` — I'll include a compat shim in examples and call it out in the changelog.

zoe (platform): Redirect PR #4390 created (WIP) with mapping: `/guides/migration.html -> /guides/migration/overview.html`. I'll also stage the link-checker WARN flip; will announce when it's live.

maya (docs): Adding `docs/merge-window` label to all related PRs and updating PR descriptions with the exact merge sequence and rollback procedure. After each merge run `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --preview-url https://deploy-preview-<PR>-redwood-docs.netlify.app` and verify anchors.

kevin (eng): :thumbsup: Also monitor CDN TTLs post-merge. If the old path persists we may need to purge edge cache for the specific route.

zoe (platform): WARN flip scheduled 13:55 PT. I'll post here when it's active. Also prepared a short CDN purge script: `scripts/purge-cdn.sh /guides/migration.html` if needed.

ci-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4390 successful: no broken links detected

maya (docs): Great — #4390 merged. Proceeding to merge #4380 now. Kevin, please review and approve when ready. Running smoke after merge.

kevin (eng): Reviewing now. Small comment about a relative link in the migration doc — leaving a suggested edit. Approving after that.

ci-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4380 updated: 0 broken links after redirect present

maya (docs): #4380 merged. Running smoke: `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --preview-url https://deploy-preview-4380--redwood-docs.netlify.app` -> anchors OK. Proceed to #4384.

leo (docs): Merging #4384 next. It removes the temporary redirect mapping and updates example permalinks. I'll keep a short note in the top of the migration guide for external links.

ci-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4384 succeeded: minor link warnings only

zoe (platform): WARN flip ended. CDN purge queued for 60s after merge in case of stale caches.

maya (docs): Finally merging #4387 (snippets). Leo, thanks for shim. After everything is merged we'll run a full link-check across the site and close the cascade.

leo (docs): Done — #4387 merged. Added a changelog entry and compatibility note.

ci-bot: [ci] full-link-check: success — no broken anchors found across site

maya (docs): Nice work team. Notes for follow-up: (1) add a short playbook entry for multi-PR docs refactors (redirect-first pattern), (2) consider automating a temporary-redirect helper in the docs CLI, (3) add an internal pre-merge checklist for link-checker WARN flip. I'll open a small meta-PR for the playbook.

kevin (eng): Agree, playbook would help avoid ad-hoc coordination next time.

zoe (platform): I'll prototype the helper and share next week.

maya (docs): Thanks all — closing this thread. If anything regresses open a new thread with the `docs/merge-window` label.
